20169.long_desc:
A professional 32-inch Arcade LCD Monitor frame package with full HD 1080P that has been designed by Arcooda for arcade machines. This A grade arcade monitor offers 16:9 viewing ratio with VGA and HDMI inputs and supports 15khz, 25khz 31khz as well as high definition up to 1920x1080 resolution. 1.3ms low response time, great colour depth, audio out and with complete Mounting frame with Glass insert designed to fit all Xtreme, Vewlix and Chewlix arcade machines The Arcooda 32inch arcade LCD monitor is a industry designed, custom arcade monitor for use in traditional arcade gaming. It offers a number of features that include; - VGA & HDMI input, for RGB input, use the Arcooda RGB board - video input support offers 15khz, 25khz, 31khz, and up to 1080p at low monitor lag - mounting frame supports the following machines Arcooda Xtreme, Taito Vewlix, and Chewlix arcade cabinets. It also includes VESA (16 x M6*18) mount support and side mounting brackets depending on your cabinet type. - many monitor adjustments that include auto-picture, fine tuning options and viewing ratios (keep the 4:3 ratio or display at 16:9). - extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount in the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine. The Arcooda 32" LCD Arcade Monitor is ready for all your arcade action and has been specially designed for arcade machines without the need for video converters. With full black metal case, mounting brackets and separate monitor adjustment board, installation is super easy and little technical skill needed. Simply plug in your game boards and cables and you're ready to go! RoHs certified, this All-in-One 32Inch Monitor and Mounting Frame Bundle comes with 12 months warranty.

NEW UPGRADED MODEL NOW OFFERS;

V36 Firmware - a wider range of 15khz arcade game board titles supported including 50,54 60 and 70Hz titles such as NBA Jam / Mortal Kombat, supports 24khz game titles such as Daytona USA & Virtua Striker, and all 31khz titles up to 1080P. - offers 7 menu languages, updated auto picture functions, quicker transition between video signal resolutions, and more. Cabinet Mounting Options + Monitor Panel Management - Xtreme / Vewlix / Chewlix horizontal and vertical mounting via M6 - VESA 75mm, 100mm and 200mm mounting via M6 - Xtreme frame, or custom glass frame mounting via M4 (via side frame mount) - Cable management support with 4 mounting positions Audio Output Support - connect your HDMI input into the Arcooda 32inch arcade LCD monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system. Xtreme Vewlix Chewlix Frame - All-in-One 32Inch Monitor and Mounting Frame Bundle can mount directly into Taito Vewlix, Chewlix, or Game Wizard Xtreme 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0 arcade cabinets. Breakout OSD Menu Board - access the monitor menu via the regular monitor buttons on the metal cabinet, or, use the 160cm extension cable to mount a secondary monitor adjustment board anywhere in your cabinet. No longer do you need a second person to help adjust the monitor settings. Confirmed Plug and Play Suitable Arcade Cabinets - Game Wizard Xtreme 1 - Game Wizard Xtreme 2.0 - Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 - Taito Vewlix L - Taito Vewlix FC - Taito Vewlix Diamond - Chewlix (if based on Vewlix shell, check your existing monitor frame) Our Monitor Set Includes: - 32inch Arcooda Full Range Monitor - Metal Frame With Glass Front and VESA Rear Mount - Spacers for Monitor Adjustment - Cable Management Accessories - VESA Screws - RGB to VGA Color Potentiometer Board - OSD Monitor Board - 1.6m extension cable for OSD board - VGA Cable - HDMI Cable - Power Cable
